channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Higgins succeeds McMahon in Naas
item.description: Naas have turned to Cavan man Jimmy Higgins in their quest to regain the Kildare SFC title in 2026.

item.title: Camogie Association announce Karen Dessain-Gelinet as new Ard Stiúrthóir
item.description: The Camogie Association has announced Karen Dessain-Gelinet as their new CEO.

item.title: Clifford coaches alma mater to Munster U17 success
item.description: St Brendan's College, Killarney retained the Frewen Cup (Munster Post Primary Schools U17 'A' Championship) yesterday with David Clifford fronting their management team.

item.title: Martin joins Gilroy at Hawthorn
item.description: Tipperary's Niamh Martin has joined Hawthorn from North Melbourne in the AFLW.

item.title: Man sentenced for attempted pipe bomb attack at Belfast GAA club
item.description: A 59-year-old man who left pipe bombs at a GAA ground in Belfast has been handed a three-year sentence, with half in jail and half in licence.

item.title: Corn Uí Dhúill quarter-final draw takes place
item.description: The draw has been made for the quarter-finals of the Corn Uí Dhúill (Leinster Post Primary Schools Senior 'A' Hurling Championship).

item.title: Cork City Council honours Patrick Horgan
item.description: Patrick 'Hoggie' Horgan was accorded a civic reception by Cork Lord Mayor, Cllr Fergal Dennehy, this week to mark his extraordinary contribution to sporting life in the city.

item.title: Full amalgamation of Laois clubs falls through
item.description: The proposed merger of Laois GAA clubs Ballinakill and Ballypickas has collapsed.

item.title: GAA on TV: All-Ireland and Ulster finals down for decision
item.description: Christmas may only be around the corner, but the big games keep coming in ladies football, camogie and Gaelic football.

item.title: "It would be huge. It would go down in history in our club"
item.description: She has tasted All-Ireland success as a camogie player in the recent past and now Katie Nolan will be hoping to claim national honours with the footballers of Muckalee in Parnell Park tomorrow afternoon.
